notes: Vemoa is Hungarian-first: a message whose language is not given (or not hu|en) is sent as hu — a per-app fallback, unlike apps that fall back to en.
A key is the name as the code emits it (underscores or hyphens): the wire name is vemoa-<key>-<locale>.
Variables are scalars. `*_label` and `amount` are ready-made words in the message language; the raw code/amount_minor stay for conditions.

Do not use ventMail-reserved names for variables (unsubscribe_url, preferences_url, browser_url, recipient_email, current_year): ventMail overwrites them. Vemoa's own opt-out link is optout_url; ventMail's List-Unsubscribe still works and arrives as the unsubscribed webhook.
Transactional mail is sent with o:tracking=no; the unsubscribe links are /unsubscribe/... so a rewriting tracker leaves them alone.

Marketing keys (rebook_nudge, birthday_greeting, win_back, fill_offer) go on the marketing channel, closed until ventMail opens it; review_request stays transactional with an opt-out (owner/DPO question open).
